Definition: God — the supreme Creator, ruler and Father; the central word for deity throughout the Greek Scriptures.
BiblicalUsage: Theos appears over 1,300 times in the New Testament. The Bible never argues theos into existence; it announces Him — the God who is for us, who so loved the world, who rewards those who seek Him.
TheologicalSignificance: Theos is the anchor behind the anchor: if God is for us, who can be against us? Every word study in this collection finally points back to Him.
